title: Implement candidate handoff and event-completion workflows
description:
An authenticated numeric source-freeze identity is converted into one protected candidate tag whose push records the sole candidate-event completion identity.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Reviewer-authorized dispatch accepts only a numeric freeze artifact ID, verifies its exact non-expired digest, schema, attestation, trusted run, protected remote SHA/tree, repository, actor, and workflow identities, and uploads one overwrite-forbidden 90-day handoff/prepared record before ref mutation.
- [hard] REQ-02: The fixed-ref authority creates the annotated candidate tag with the exact handoff and freeze-root identities; creator readback verifies the tag object and peeled SHA without acting as the push run's authority.
- [hard] REQ-03: The App-authored push workflow verifies event, tag, SHA, actor, repository, workflow, and embedded handoff/root identities, then uploads one candidate-event-completed or exact recovery-completed record and exposes its ID through typed outputs.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fixtures reject missing, foreign, expired, listed-by-name, mismatched, movable, human-created, or conflicting identity, unsafe retry, source modification, and any validation, candidate-byte, escrow, registry, or release operation.

## Notes

Blast radius: freeze-ID dispatch, candidate handoff and protected tag workflow YAML, push-owned completion plumbing, and identity/crash fixtures only.
